Protests over education and rising living costs recently turned violent in parts of Europe. Which city announced curfews in response?
evidence: Localized curfews in Paris and restrictions on gatherings in parts of France were imposed as the country reels from its worst protests in years.

question_sentence: What did the Trump administration remove from a public park in Washington, DC, sparking a legal battle?
evidence: President Trump’s makeover of a public golf course has landed in court. A key dispute in the case centers on the administration’s removal of 400-plus trees from the park earlier this month.

question_sentence: Which Canadian province recently voted to remain part of Canada?
evidence: The oil-rich province of Alberta has rejected the path to secession and will remain part of Canada, landing a definitive blow to a fringe but loud campaign which sought support from the US.

question_sentence: Who is the subject of the film “You Can See Everything,” one of the biggest documentary releases in decades?
evidence: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s genre-bending film about disgraced Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes made more than $15 million in ticket sales during its opening weekend.

question_sentence: A recent expedition to find Amelia Earhart’s missing plane in the South Pacific found which of the following?
evidence: The expedition came up empty. Researchers said Monday they found “no conclusive evidence” that the famed aviator landed her aircraft on or near Nikumaroro Island, where they had focused their search.

question_sentence: A community is reeling from a deadly school shooting involving a 16-year-old gunman. Where did it happen?
evidence: Investigators are still trying to determine how the 16-year-old behind the recent school shooting in Bend, Oregon, obtained a gun and ammunition — and whether his parents could be held responsible.

question_sentence: Elon Musk recently announced plans to give every child in America a share of which company?
evidence: Elon Musk has said he will give every child in America a stake in SpaceX, his $2 trillion aerospace and artificial intelligence company, as tech firms face intensifying scrutiny over their impact on society.

question_sentence: Which two MLB teams are facing off in the 2026 World Series?
choices: Milwaukee Brewers vs. Tampa Bay Rays
Philadelphia Phillies vs. Toronto Blue Jays
evidence: The Milwaukee Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays are facing off in the World Series, with baseball’s biggest prize on the line.

question_sentence: What is the name of the strongest storm on the planet so far this year?
evidence: Champi, a storm system currently churning in the western Pacific, became the strongest storm on the planet this year, with sustained winds reaching 185 mph — equivalent to a Category 5 hurricane.

question_sentence: What is the name of Apple's new foldable iPhone?
evidence: The iPhone Duo, Apple’s first foldable iPhone, launched this week with a starting price of $2,000. CNN tech editor Lisa Eadicicco says the device is impressive, but most apps are still designed for a much smaller screen.
